title: Find FNDDS survey foods by description (April 2019)
purpose: Find FNDDS survey foods in this FoodData Central release whose description contains a phrase (case-insensitive; SQL wildcards % and _ keep their meaning), with each food's FDC id, food code, description, WWEIA category and publication date. An exact description match comes first, then shorter descriptions.

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: Phrase to look for; empty text lists every FNDDS survey food

output_columns.name: fdc_id
output_columns.description: FoodData Central id of the food

output_columns.name: wweia_category
output_columns.description: WWEIA food category description as published
